nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and mutable by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, initialized to YCBF in the constructor.
Public token name string, initialized to 'Yearn Coin Barter Finance'.
Public token decimals value, fixed at 18.
Total token supply, minted entirely to the hardcoded deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance, mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Pure helper adding two uints and requiring the result to be >= the first operand.
Pure helper subtracting two uints after requiring b <= a.
Pure helper multiplying two uints and requiring a == 0 or c / a == b.
Pure helper dividing two uints after requiring a non-zero divisor.
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner for later acceptance.
Two-step ownership handover completion; requires msg.sender == newOwner and then clears newOwner.
Constructor that sets token metadata, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub and safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval without any double-spend guard.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to', updating balances and allowed.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract, an external call to an arbitrary address.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance keys and allowance keys throughout the contract.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; overflow protection relies on a post-hoc require.
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by the division round-trip check.
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate applied by the onlyOwner modifier.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) access-control gate inside acceptOwnership.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state updates, enabling reentrancy into the token.
Subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed in totalSupply without a SafeMath helper.

edges.reason: safeAdd executes the raw addition before the require overflow check.
safeSub performs the subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the multiplication and validates it via division.
safeDiv performs the division after checking the divisor is non-zero.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
totalSupply performs an unguarded subtraction of balances[address(0)].
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied spender contract after mutating allowed.
safeAdd's first addend flows into the addition operand.
safeAdd's second addend flows into the addition operand.
safeSub's minuend flows into the subtraction operand.
safeSub's subtrahend flows into the subtraction operand.
safeMul's first factor flows into the multiplication operand.
safeMul's second factor flows into the multiplication operand.
safeDiv's dividend flows into the division operand.
safeDiv's divisor flows into the division operand.
Local c stores the result of the addition inside safeAdd.
Local c stores the result of the subtraction inside safeSub.
Local c stores the result of the multiplication inside safeMul.
Local c stores the result of the division inside safeDiv.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
Owned constructor assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
msg.sender of the deployer is the implicit minter context of the token constructor.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited balance key.
approve uses msg.sender as the first allowance mapping key.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall grants an allowance to a spender chosen by the caller and calls it back.
Constructor writes msg.sender into owner.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Token constructor initializes symbol.
Token constructor initializes name.
Token constructor initializes decimals.
Token constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Token constructor mints the entire supply into balances of the hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply as the subtraction base.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the unguarded subtrahend.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the given account.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer debits the sender using safeSub.
transfer credits the recipient using safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates both the source and destination balances.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom subtracts from balances[from] and from the allowance via safeSub.
transferFrom credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external callback.
The _newOwner argument flows into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner selects the balance entry returned by balanceOf.
Recipient of transfer is credited in balances.
Token amount of transfer feeds safeSub and safeAdd.
spender is used as the second key in the allowed mapping.
tokens is written as the allowance value in approve.
from is the account debited in transferFrom.
to is the account credited in transferFrom.
tokens drives the balance and allowance subtractions in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is the outer key used by allowance.
spender is the inner key used by allowance.
spender receives the allowance and is the address called back in approveAndCall.
tokens is both the granted allowance and the forwarded callback amount.
Attacker-controlled data is forwarded into the receiveApproval callback.
